targets.queryText: WITH ranked_days AS (SELECT gd.game_day, gd.day_meta_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gd.game_day ORDER BY gd.imported_at DESC) AS rn FROM gameplay_days gd WHERE gd.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(gd.release_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR ('unity-all' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) AND lower(COALESCE(gd.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' AND lower(COALESCE(gd.client_version, '')) NOT LIKE '%dev%'))), event_types AS (SELECT game_day, group_concat(event_type, '、') AS event_types FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ge.game_day, ge.event_type FROM gameplay_events ge WHERE ge.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(ge.release_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR ('unity-all' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) AND lower(COALESCE(ge.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' AND lower(COALESCE(ge.client_version, '')) NOT LIKE '%dev%')) ORDER BY ge.event_type) GROUP BY game_day) SELECT rd.game_day AS 日期, rd.day_meta_json AS metadata, COALESCE(et.event_types, '-') AS event_type FROM ranked_days rd LEFT JOIN event_types et ON et.game_day = rd.game_day WHERE rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY rd.game_day ASC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH ranked_days AS (SELECT gd.game_day, gd.day_meta_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gd.game_day ORDER BY gd.imported_at DESC) AS rn FROM gameplay_days gd WHERE gd.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(gd.release_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR ('unity-all' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) AND lower(COALESCE(gd.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' AND lower(COALESCE(gd.client_version, '')) NOT LIKE '%dev%'))), event_types AS (SELECT game_day, group_concat(event_type, '、') AS event_types FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ge.game_day, ge.event_type FROM gameplay_events ge WHERE ge.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(ge.release_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR ('unity-all' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) AND lower(COALESCE(ge.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' AND lower(COALESCE(ge.client_version, '')) NOT LIKE '%dev%')) ORDER BY ge.event_type) GROUP BY game_day) SELECT rd.game_day AS 日期, rd.day_meta_json AS metadata, COALESCE(et.event_types, '-') AS event_type FROM ranked_days rd LEFT JOIN event_types et ON et.game_day = rd.game_day WHERE rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY rd.game_day ASC

targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(c.timestamp, '+8 hours') AS '时间(北京)', CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(c.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' THEN 'Unity' WHEN COALESCE(c.client_version, '') = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'Non-Unity' END AS '客户端', COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)') AS '版本', COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, '') AS '昵称', c.user_id AS '用户ID', c.country AS '国家', c.user_query AS '玩家消息', c.ai_response AS 'AI回复', c.ai_action AS 'AI动作', c.duration_ms AS '延迟(ms)', c.prompt_tokens AS 'Prompt', c.completion_tokens AS 'Completion' FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.message_type, ''), 'chat') = 'chat' AND (COALESCE(c.user_query, '') != '' OR COALESCE(c.ai_response, '') != '') ORDER BY c.timestamp DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(c.timestamp, '+8 hours') AS '时间(北京)', CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(c.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' THEN 'Unity' WHEN COALESCE(c.client_version, '') = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'Non-Unity' END AS '客户端', COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)') AS '版本', COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, '') AS '昵称', c.user_id AS '用户ID', c.country AS '国家', c.user_query AS '玩家消息', c.ai_response AS 'AI回复', c.ai_action AS 'AI动作', c.duration_ms AS '延迟(ms)', c.prompt_tokens AS 'Prompt', c.completion_tokens AS 'Completion' FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.message_type, ''), 'chat') = 'chat' AND (COALESCE(c.user_query, '') != '' OR COALESCE(c.ai_response, '') != '') ORDER BY c.timestamp DESC

list.definition: WITH release_stats AS (SELECT 'unity-all' AS release_label, 'unity-all' AS value, NULL AS latest_seen UNION SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version, ''), '(empty)') AS release_label, COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version, ''), '__empty__') AS value, MAX(COALESCE(real_time_started_iso, imported_at)) AS latest_seen FROM gameplay_sessions GROUP BY release_version) SELECT CASE WHEN value NOT IN ('unity-all', '__empty__') AND latest_seen IS NOT NULL THEN release_label || ' @ ' || datetime(latest_seen, '+8 hours') || ' BJ' ELSE release_label END AS __text, value AS __value FROM release_stats ORDER BY CASE WHEN value = 'unity-all' THEN 0 WHEN value = 'unity-dev' THEN 1 WHEN value = '__empty__' THEN 4 ELSE 2 END, latest_seen DESC, value
